nodes.label: voltagent/awesome-design-md
nodes.rationale: Upstream GitHub repository (commit 8147538b4226ae41e2487a9179e3bcc1f68e8554, MIT licensed) from which all 14 DESIGN.md files in this library are vendored verbatim; has 70+ brands total, of which only the 14 sharing Rekono's B2B SaaS/fintech/dev-tool genre were selected.

nodes.label: taste-skill
nodes.rationale: Companion skill supplying the audit-first process, the anti-genericness checklist, and the reminder that its own rules are contextual; scoped to landing/marketing pages, not the app dashboard, and that scope carries over to design-references as well.

nodes.label: Rekono Marketing Site 'Virtual Ledger' Theme
nodes.rationale: Rekono's own deliberately-chosen marketing visual identity (slab-serif display face, blue accent, liquid-glass panels), arrived at intentionally rather than defaulted into; the design-references library exists to inform this identity's gaps, never to be copied over it.

nodes.label: Figma Design System
nodes.rationale: Product-craft benchmark from a company whose own product is design. Monochrome black/white chrome makes oversized pastel color-block sections read as intentional storytelling panels rather than decoration; the system deliberately avoids shadows and gradients, using saturated color blocks as the sole depth device.

nodes.label: Intercom Design System
nodes.rationale: Product-led marketing narrative: a warm cream canvas (never pure white) signals editorial calm, while Fin Orange is deliberately restricted to the Fin AI product accent so it never dilutes into a generic brand color.

nodes.label: Linear Design System
nodes.rationale: Single type family across all weights; a four-step dark surface ladder plus hairline borders replaces drop-shadow elevation entirely; positive-tracked eyebrow labels act as taxonomy against negative-tracked display type.

nodes.label: Mastercard Design System
nodes.rationale: Enterprise trust signaling via a warm putty-cream canvas and an extreme border-radius scale that deliberately skips the common 8-12px middle ground, committing instead to either small, 20-40px, or full-pill radii; circular orbital portrait motif implies a constellation of services.

nodes.label: Notion Design System
nodes.rationale: Flexible, componentized marketing system at scale. Buttons are deliberately rectangular at 8px radius, not pills, to distinguish Notion's sober geometry from pill-everywhere competitors; pastel card-tint palette echoes the live product's colorful database properties.

nodes.label: Resend Design System
nodes.rationale: Rekono's own transactional email provider; minimal, dev-focused marketing on a true pure-black canvas. An editorial Domaine Display serif headline and translucent-white hairline borders (never drop shadows) carry the brand's print-magazine confidence.

nodes.label: Revolut Design System
nodes.rationale: Bold color used deliberately in a compliance-heavy category. A two-mode black/white canvas switches in full-bleed bands; cobalt-violet is reserved only for the featured plan card and secondary CTAs, never as the main hero action color.

nodes.label: Sentry-Inspired Design System
nodes.rationale: Technical-audience marketing that stays warm, not just terminal-dark. A two-polarity canvas system (violet midnight for hero/product, white for pricing/contact) never blends the two; a single lime-green keyword highlight is kept scarce so it stays a signature rather than a palette color.

nodes.label: Slack-Inspired Design System
nodes.rationale: Approachable-but-serious enterprise tone. A single deep aubergine primary is reused as chromatic monotheism across the CTA, the featured pricing tier, and the closing footer band; pastel-mesh gradients behind floating product-UI mockups substitute for literal drop-shadow depth.

nodes.label: Stripe Design System
nodes.rationale: Fintech infrastructure trust signal via tabular-figure money type and single-indigo CTA discipline (per SKILL.md's stated rationale). A pastel/indigo/ruby gradient mesh occupies the upper third of nearly every page as the brand's sole atmospheric depth device.

nodes.label: Superhuman-Inspired Design System
nodes.rationale: Trust-first, exclusivity-inflected tone without looking cold. Sub-default variable font weights (460/540/600, never the standard 400/500/700) give the editorial dark hero a deliberate warmth; every page resolves in a signature deep-teal closing CTA band.

nodes.label: Vercel Design System
nodes.rationale: Dark-canvas product marketing with screenshot-as-protagonist layout. A multi-stop cyan/blue/magenta/amber mesh gradient is the brand's only decorative chrome, reserved for hero scale only; elevation is built from stacked subtle shadows plus an inset hairline ring, never a single heavy drop-shadow.

nodes.label: Wise Design System
nodes.rationale: Bold weight and one saturated brand color read as trustworthy, not just navy restraint. A single lime-green CTA accent is the sole identity color; hero display type runs an unusually heavy weight 900, never lighter, as the brand's typographic signature.

nodes.label: Zapier Design System
nodes.rationale: Same 'automate a business process' pitch shape as Rekono's own product. Warm-cream canvas and deep coffee ink (never pure white/black) carry the brand's temperature signal; a single saturated orange is the entire chromatic accent, paired with a deliberate middle 12px button/card radius.

nodes.label: Surface-Ladder Elevation Principle
nodes.rationale: Depth communicated via a stepped surface-luminance ladder (canvas -> surface-1 through surface-4) plus hairline borders, resisting drop shadows almost entirely on a dark canvas. Cited by SKILL.md as the exemplar reasoning behind 'why does Linear resist drop shadows?'.

nodes.label: Tabular-Figure Money Type Principle
nodes.rationale: Every cell rendering currency, transaction amounts, or numeric counts uses OpenType 'tnum' plus a tightening tracking, as a quiet, near-invisible signal that the brand is financial infrastructure. Cited by SKILL.md as the archetypal 'principle behind a choice' worth extracting rather than copying Stripe's literal indigo hex.
